jei.jaymospowers.prospector_pick: Forged at the Tool Station from a copper Prospector's Pick Head, a Tool Handle and a Tool Binding. Use it on rock to hear what ore lies within 12 blocks: nothing, traces, or a lot. It never says where.
jei.jaymospowers.pan: Use it on gravel or sand that water touches. Now and then a panful turns up a copper or gold nugget, rarely iron, or flint. The bank washes away in time.
jei.jaymospowers.sluice: Fill it with gravel or sand (up to 8) and set it beside running water, not a still source. It washes a load every few seconds on its own, finding a little more than a pan, and drops what it finds in front.
jei.jaymospowers.support_beam: Mining stone under a roof can shake it down in a cave-in. A support beam, upright or on its side, holds the roof up for 4 blocks round. Setting one while the dust falls still saves it.
